intro: Football is Syria's most popular sport, and its fans followed the national team through years of war.

chapters.title: Football
text: Syria came close to qualifying for the 2018 World Cup. Al-Jaish and Al-Ittihad of Aleppo have won Asian club competitions.

chapters.title: Olympics
text: Ghada Shouaa won Syria's only Olympic gold, in the heptathlon in 1996.

keyTerms.meaning: A seven-event athletics contest for women.
